description:
What is 4F-ADB | 4f-MDMB-Binaca

Buy 4f-mph powder (also known as4-Fluoromethylphenidate and 4-FMPH) is a stimulant drug. It acts as a higher potency dopamine reuptake inhibitor than the closely related methylphenidate.

4F-ADB or 4F-MDMB-Binaca is a synthetic cannabinoid that has been found in products marketed as “legal highs.” It’s an agonist of the CB1 receptor (EC50 = 7.39 nM), but it’s not clear whether it is specific to this target. 4F-ADB was created in order to avoid the banning of 4F-MPH, which is a similar compound.
